The untestable checkpoints (eyes, digits) do not detract from alignment as they are obscured by natural pose/angle, not missing due to generation error.

This is a moderate structural flaw (Severity ~2.0). There is also minor edge softness at the front shoulder. However, the rest of the image is sharp, well-grounded, and free of noise or compression artifacts. The high mask confidence (0.95) indicates the main body is topologically sound. The artifact score is penalized for the tail fusion but remains high due to the overall cleanliness of the generation.
